content.comment_body: I have an electronic pressure controller and want to use my analog output to set four different pressure levels, each triggered by three push buttons. The High push button should send a 6 volt signal to the pressure regulator, the Low push button a 3 volt signal, and the String-in button sends a 4 volt signal, followed by a 4.2 volt signal after 3 seconds. I'm new to [product_name] programming and would appreciate a ladder logic solution. Thank you, [user_name]
Using ladder logic with [product_name] may not be ideal. Function block diagram (FBD) is a better choice in this case. However, I have attached the ladder logic program if you still want to use it.
